format: PERF_OPTIMIZATION_DESIGN_v1.md section 9.4, plus app / advisory_ref / priority / prerequisites

priority_legend.P1: semantic change confined to one handler; needs only the H1(a) same-call-multiset relaxation + full stage-A re-acceptance
priority_legend.P2: data-model / template change; architect re-issues the blueprint, then code-developer + sam-engineer
priority_legend.P3: changes failure semantics; blocked on differential testing against the monolith (section 12)
priority_legend.P4: async / retry / config; architect decision or L3 measurement

diagnosis.evidence: one GetItem per product before any result is used; each followed by a 500 path.
